description.value: Delta Grove is one of four campgrounds at popular Cultus Lake Provincial Park, set beside a large warm freshwater lake ringed by forested mountains about 90 minutes from Vancouver. Full amenities include showers and flush toilets, but gates close in the off-season making this a summer-only destination that draws big crowds.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Delta Grove Campground is one of four campgrounds within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, a BC Parks site 11km southwest of Chilliwack. The BC Parks page has a 'Book camping' link and reservation policies section, confirming reservations are accepted. The website states the nearby community of Cultus Lake offers 'restaurants, laundromat, stores, and gas stations,' confirming food availability nearby. No specific mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, or other cycling-specific amenities in the fetched text. The OSM phone belongs to the operator (Sea to Sky Park Services Ltd.), not BC Parks directly, and is not corroborated on the fetched page.
